choices.label: How many times each coordinate has been added.

questions.prompt: Which stored points can be horizontal partners for a queried corner?

choices.label: Any point at a different coordinate, regardless of direction.
choices.feedback: A horizontal square side must have positive length and keep the y coordinate unchanged.

choices.label: Points with both the same x and the same y.

choices.label: Points with the same y coordinate and a different x coordinate.
choices.feedback: A horizontal square side must have positive length and keep the y coordinate unchanged.

questions.prompt: How should the number of squares for three required stored corners be counted?

choices.label: Multiply the three corner counts.
choices.feedback: Any copy of each required corner can be combined with copies of the other two, producing a product of counts.

choices.label: Add the three corner counts.
choices.feedback: Any copy of each required corner can be combined with copies of the other two, producing a product of counts.

choices.label: Count one square whenever all three coordinates exist.
choices.feedback: Any copy of each required corner can be combined with copies of the other two, producing a product of counts.
